title: dacryodes barteri
intro: Dacryodes barteri, commonly known as African palm or Benin palm, is a tropical plant species belonging to the family Burseraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as relief from respiratory issues, skin irritations, and inflammation due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dacryodes barteri include anti-anxiety, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and immune response. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
